roadmap.intro: A practical sequence teams use to de-risk FinTech delivery: clarity first, then architecture, then compliance depth, then sustainable launch.

foundation.title: Discovery & positioning
foundation.description: Define the problem, customer, and economics; sketch the regulatory perimeter (licensing, sandbox, or partnership models) before major build commitments.

architecture.title: Product & systems design
architecture.description: Shape the MVP, core flows, and integrations—payments, identity, ledgering—so security and scalability are designed in, not bolted on late.

compliance.title: Compliance & risk
compliance.description: Align AML/KYC, data protection, and supervisory expectations with your operating model; prepare evidence and controls auditors and partners expect.

launch.title: Launch & iteration
launch.description: Go live with observability and incident readiness, then tighten the loop: metrics, feedback, and roadmap updates as the product and rules evolve.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: I'm Mohammed. I spend most of my time where regulated FinTech meets real engineering—helping teams make clearer product calls, tighter architecture, and calmer compliance conversations.
about.authorBio: I didn't start from slides—I started from delivery pressure, ambiguous requirements, and regulators who expect evidence, not vibes. Today I consult, architect, and write so founders and operators waste less time guessing. Maal Tech is my umbrella for that work: the blog is my public notebook; the rest is direct collaboration when we're a good fit.
about.signatureLine: You work with me—not a faceless team

fintechFundamentals.title: Fintech Fundamentals
fintechFundamentals.subtitle: Your Complete Guide to Understanding Fintech in the Saudi Market
fintechFundamentals.description: A comprehensive 4-module learning journey that takes you from understanding the basics of banking and fintech to mastering regulatory compliance and Saudi financial regulations.

overview.title: Why This Course?
overview.description: A course designed specifically for the Saudi market, combining global fintech concepts with local application. You'll learn how banks and fintech companies operate, understand Saudi regulations from SAMA and CMA, and gain practical skills that are in high demand.

comprehensive.title: Saudi Market Focus
comprehensive.description: Tailored content covering local regulations with examples from Saudi companies

practical.title: Practical Applications
practical.description: Case studies from companies like STC Pay, Tamara, and Lendo with interactive exercises

expert.title: Real market experience
expert.description: Gain practical exposure to how fintech and banking work in the real market
